tool.name: Biomni: Annotate Plasmid
tool.description: Annotate a DNA sequence using pLannotate's command-line interface.
tool.help:
**Biomni: Annotate Plasmid**
Annotate a DNA sequence using pLannotate's command-line interface.
Args: sequence (str): The DNA sequence to annotate is_circular (bool): Whether the sequence is circular (default: True) return_plot (bool): Whether to return the Bokeh plot object (default: False)
Returns: Dict: Dictionary containing annotation results or None if annotation fails
**Domain**: molecular_biology **Function**: annotate_plasmid
